limitations: Generated adult-voice audio is an engineering baseline, not evidence of child, accent, noise, naturalness or learning performance. Mixed-language SAPI pronunciation is itself a confounder.

samples.text: 测距模块告诉主控离墙有多远，电机让小车动起来。
The distance sensor tells the controller how far away the wall is. The motor moves the car.
不对，我还没有完成实验，只是打算把停车距离改成二十厘米。
I have not finished the experiment. I only plan to change the stopping distance to twenty centimeters.
先不要告诉我答案，给我一个小提示，再让我自己试一次。
Please give me one small hint, then let me try again on my own.
第一次用了三点五秒，第二次用了两秒，我们要比较的是同一段距离。
The first run took three point five seconds. The second took two seconds over the same distance.
我想比较 distance sensor 和电机的作用。
The motor is the 电机. Can you explain it in both languages?
